title: Correction takes — wrong stored assumption is not repeated after explicit correction
description: Mara explicitly corrects an assumption: she never said she was thinking about going back to law, and she is not. The companion must accept the correction cleanly, not defend it, not hedge, and not bring it up again. This is the only fully automatable B7 eval — it requires only that banned phrases stay out of the reply after the correction.
pass_proves: The system updates its model of the user when explicitly corrected and does not re-assert the corrected claim.
fail_reveals: The system defends the incorrect memory, hedges, or re-raises the corrected claim in the same response.
why_naive_fails: Retrieve-then-speak re-injects session summaries containing any law-return framing and the model repeats it despite the correction.
